candidates.title: Horrific Road Accident in East Godavari: Tipper Lorry Rams RTC Bus, Children Among the Injured
candidates.excerpt: A serious road accident occurred near Sigaramma Chinta in Gokavaram mandal of Andhra Pradesh's East Godavari district when a tipper lorry allegedly rammed into an Andhra Pradesh State Road Transport Corporation (APSRTC) bus from behind.

candidates.title: Mahabubnagar: Farmers protest after alleged police assault on land compensation claimant
candidates.excerpt: Farmers have protested against the Jadcherla police over the alleged assault of Uddandapur farmer Narsimhulu, who sought compensation for land acquired for a reservoir. Videos purportedly showing police personnel dragging and verbally abusing him have circulated on social media.
